name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 3 visits over 12 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 16 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 11 hours starting 2026-05-20, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.73 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
